whatAreBridges.title: What Are Dental Bridges?
whatAreBridges.description: Dental bridges are fixed dental restorations used to replace one or more missing teeth by bridging the gap between healthy teeth or dental implants.
items: Looks natural and blends with existing teeth
whatAreBridges.footnote: If you're searching for a reliable option to replace missing teeth, looking for dental bridges near me is an excellent choice.

bridgeTypes.title: Types of Dental Bridges Available Near You

items.title: Traditional Dental Bridge
items.description: The most common option for replacing one or more missing teeth using crowns placed on adjacent teeth.

items.title: Cantilever Bridge
items.description: Recommended when there is only one supporting tooth next to the missing space.

items.title: Maryland Dental Bridge
items.description: Uses a metal or ceramic framework bonded to the back of neighboring teeth, requiring minimal tooth preparation.

items.title: Implant-Supported Bridge
items.description: Ideal for replacing multiple missing teeth with additional strength and long-term stability using dental implants for support.

items.question: How long do dental bridges last?
items.answer: With proper oral hygiene and regular dental check-ups, dental bridges can last many years.

items.question: Are dental bridges comfortable?
items.answer: Yes. Once adjusted properly, dental bridges feel natural and allow comfortable eating and speaking.

items.question: How long does the dental bridge procedure take?
items.answer: Treatment usually requires two or more visits, depending on the type of bridge and individual requirements.

items.question: Who is a suitable candidate for dental bridges?
items.answer: Most people with one or more missing teeth and healthy supporting teeth or implants are suitable candidates.

items.question: What is the cost of dental bridges in Pune?
